apps.name: Dream Eater: AI Dream Decoder
apps.description:
You wake at 3 a.m. with a dream still vivid. Type it into Dream Eater and within seconds you get a thoughtful reading of what it might mean, plus a piece of dream art generated from your own words. Your first reading is free.

DECODE THE MEANING
Describe your dream in your own words and receive an AI-powered interpretation: the key symbols, the emotional undercurrents, and what your subconscious might be working through. A built-in symbol dictionary helps you go deeper on recurring images.

DREAM ART YOU CAN SHARE
Every analyzed dream comes with a unique image generated from your dream's own imagery. Save it, share it, or keep it as the cover of that night's entry.

A JOURNAL BUILT FOR 3AM
Capture dreams fast, while they are still fresh. Big type, minimal taps, and no account setup standing between you and the half-remembered. Writing in your journal is always free.

PATTERNS OVER TIME
Moods, themes, and recurring symbols surface across weeks of entries, so you can see what your sleeping mind keeps returning to.

MOON PHASES
Each entry records the moon phase from that night, and lunar info is always on hand if you like tracking your dreams against the sky.

TRY PREMIUM FREE FOR 7 DAYS
Start a 7-day free trial on the annual plan and analyze unlimited dreams. Cancel anytime during the trial and pay nothing.

OR PAY PER DREAM
Prefer no subscription right now? Buy credit packs of 5, 15, 50, or 100 dream analyses. Credits never expire.

Dream Eater is for entertainment and self-reflection. It is not a medical, psychological, or therapeutic tool.

Privacy: no account required; dreams stay on your device and iCloud.

Available in English, Spanish, and Chinese.

apps.name: Psywave: AI Playlist Maker
apps.description:
Describe a mood in one line — or pick a photo — and get a real Apple Music playlist in seconds.

Psywave turns plain words and pictures into soundtracks that fit. Type a vibe, a scene, or a feeling — "drum and bass intensity," "smooth sailing yacht rock," "focus for deep work" — and a curated playlist of real songs lands in your Apple Music library with one tap. No endless scrolling. No stale stations.

WORDS IN, PLAYLIST OUT
Tell Psywave what you want to hear and it builds a tailored tracklist around your exact mood, then imports it straight into Apple Music.

PHOTOS BECOME PLAYLISTS
Point Psywave at a sunset, a road trip, a rainy window — it reads the mood, the colors, the feeling, and scores the moment with real songs.

SEE YOUR SOUND
Every playlist comes with a genre breakdown chart, so you can see exactly what your vibe is made of.

BUILT FOR YOUR MOMENT
• Workout — high-energy sets in seconds
• Focus & deep work — distraction-free flow
• Party & hosting — read the room, set the vibe
• Wind down — the right closer for a slow night

YOUR LIBRARY OF MOODS
Every playlist you generate is saved. Re-import any of them to Apple Music whenever the mood comes back.

GO PRO, OR PAY AS YOU GO
Start with 3 free playlists. Then choose Psywave Pro for unlimited playlists (with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan), or grab a credit pack and only pay for what you make. Credits never expire.

Psywave requires an Apple Music subscription to import playlists.

apps.name: Double Kick: Menu Translator
apps.description:
Standing in front of a menu you can't read? Point your camera and know exactly what to order.

Double Kick turns any foreign-language menu into a guide you actually understand. Not a word-for-word translation that leaves you guessing, but the real story behind every dish and drink: what's in it, how it's made, what it tastes like, and what it costs in your own currency. Snap one photo and decide with confidence.

KNOW WHAT YOU'RE ORDERING
- Read and translate menus in any language from a single photo
- Understand ingredients, preparation, and flavor before you commit
- See prices converted to your home currency, instantly

A REAL FOOD & DRINK EXPERT
- Explore regional specialties and global cuisines in plain language
- Decode spirits, cocktails, and wine lists that simple translators skip
- Learn the dishes behind the names, not just the words

BUILT FOR TRAVELERS
- Works on menus from street stalls to fine-dining tasting menus
- Keeps your menu history on your device for every trip
- Tracks your taste preferences across cuisines and trips

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account required, no ads, no tracking
- We don't sell your data, and your menu history stays on your device

ONE PRICE, FOREVER
No subscriptions. No ads. Buy it once and own every feature, on every trip.

The next time the menu is in a language you don't speak, you won't order blind. You'll order exactly what you want.

Photograph a menu and see for yourself.

apps.name: PixiePocket: AI Image Maker
apps.description:
Pro-grade AI images, created by chat. Pay only for what you make — no subscription, ever.

Every new creator starts with 25 free credits — enough to try Nano Banana image generation the moment the app opens. No sign-up required.

CHAT YOUR WAY TO THE IMAGE
Describe what you want, refine it message by message, and watch your image evolve. Attach a photo and edit it by talking: change hair, swap backgrounds, restyle anything.

POWERED BY NANO BANANA + GPT IMAGE
PixiePocket generates with Google's Nano Banana (Gemini) and OpenAI's GPT image models — two engines, one chat.

PAY PER IMAGE, NOT PER MONTH
Credits never expire. Buy a pack once and create whenever inspiration strikes — bigger packs carry up to 68% bonus credits. No weekly trap, no renewals, no surprise charges.

CONTROL THE OUTPUT LIKE A PRO
• Batch up to 10 images per request
• Low / Medium / High / Auto quality tiers
• Custom sizes, square to widescreen
• PNG, JPEG or WebP output, transparent backgrounds
• Live credit cost shown before you create

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
Start anonymously, then sign in with Apple, Google, or GitHub to keep your gallery in sync across devices. Share your best work to the public community gallery — or keep it all to yourself.

A NOTE ON PRIVACY & SAFETY
Your prompts and attached photos are sent to Google Gemini and OpenAI to generate images — you approve this in-app before your first creation and can withdraw consent anytime in Settings. Some prompts may be filtered by content moderation. Images shared to the community gallery can be reported in one tap and are reviewed.

Google, Gemini and Nano Banana are trademarks of Google LLC. This app is not endorsed by or affiliated with Google or OpenAI.

apps.name: App of the Dead: Religions
apps.description:
What happens after we die? Find out what 20+ world religions, ancient civilizations, and spiritual traditions actually believe — one 5-minute lesson at a time. Start free, no course required.

App of the Dead turns comparative religion into a game. Bite-sized lessons, quick quizzes, daily streaks, and XP take you from curious beginner to confident, well-read explorer — across every major faith and the great afterlife myths of history. Neutral, respectful, and built for the genuinely curious.

LEARN THROUGH PLAY
Gamified lessons inspired by the language-learning apps you already love. Multiple-choice, matching, and true/false quizzes make Olam Ha-Ba, Valhalla, reincarnation, and the Egyptian and Greek underworlds stick — without dry textbook reading.

EVERY BELIEF, SIDE BY SIDE
A gamified path through them all, not just one. Compare how Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism, Norse, Egyptian, Greek, and many more traditions answer humanity's oldest question — and see where they agree and diverge.

START FREE, FOREVER
The full Judaism path is free for life — complete lessons on Jewish afterlife beliefs and Olam Ha-Ba, no time limit, no catch. Explore it end to end before you ever pay a cent.

GO PREMIUM — EVERYTHING, ONE PLAN
Unlock all 21 paths and unlimited Oracle conversations with Premium: an annual plan with a 7-day free trial ($39.99/year in the US), or monthly at $9.99/month. Prefer to own it forever? Ultimate Enlightenment is a one-time lifetime unlock. Or add individual belief systems one at a time:
• Major faiths: Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism
• Ancient worlds: Egyptian afterlife, Greek underworld, Norse Valhalla
• Eastern traditions: Taoism, Shinto, Sikhism
• Indigenous and modern paths, and many more

BUILT TO KEEP YOU LEARNING
• Daily streaks that turn 5 minutes into a habit
• XP and levels that track real progress
• Achievements and badges for mastering each path
• Beautiful themed visuals unique to every tradition

MADE FOR
• Religious-studies and world-religions students
• Writers and worldbuilders researching authentic afterlife lore
• Travelers and the endlessly curious
• Educators and parents who want a respectful, neutral survey of faiths

Every tradition is presented with equal respect and zero proselytizing — this is education, not conversion.

Start the free Judaism path today and explore humanity's greatest mystery.

For educational purposes. App of the Dead presents all religious and spiritual traditions neutrally and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any religious organization.

apps.name: Master of Inventory: Warranty
apps.description:
Disaster doesn't wait for you to find the receipt. Photograph, value, and receipt-back everything you own now — so an insurance claim, a warranty, or a return is one tap away, not a frantic search.

Master of Inventory turns your belongings into a documented record that actually holds up: every item with a photo, purchase price, date, and scanned receipt, plus warranty and return deadlines tracked for you. Built for the household that wants to be ready before a fire, theft, flood, or move — not after.

BUILT FOR INSURANCE CLAIMS
• Photograph each item with its purchase price and date
• Attach scanned receipts as proof of ownership and value
• Produce a clear, defensible record of what you own and what it's worth
• Organize room by room and by your own custom categories

NEVER MISS A WARRANTY OR REFUND
• Track warranty expirations and get ahead of them
• Watch online-return windows so refunds don't slip away
• Keep receipts and coverage details together with each item
• Stop losing real money to deadlines you forgot

CAPTURE IN SECONDS
• Built-in document scanner for clean receipt copies
• Snap item and receipt photos for complete records
• Search and filter your whole catalog instantly
• Share an item or receipt in a couple of taps

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Stored locally with Apple's Core Data
• Optional iCloud sync across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• No third-party servers, no data mining — just your records, yours alone

WHO IT'S FOR
• Homeowners and renters documenting belongings for insurance
• Anyone tracking warranties and purchase dates
• Collectors cataloging valuables
• Small businesses keeping an asset record
• People mid-move who need an inventory fast

Start with the things that matter most — your most valuable items, your newest purchases, anything still under warranty — and build from there. Five minutes today can save a claim, a refund, and a lot of stress later.

Document what you own. Be ready before you need to be.

apps.name: SForesight: SF Symbols Search

SEARCH BY MEANING, NOT KEYWORDS
On-device ML maps your intent to the right glyph. Type an idea, get ranked suggestions that actually fit, not just literal string matches.

FIND IT FAST
Ranked results appear as you type, so you spend seconds per lookup instead of minutes scrolling a giant grid.

STAY VISUALLY CONSISTENT
Surface related symbols at a glance and keep your interface coherent across screens and platforms.

ONE-CLICK COPY
Grab the exact symbol name with a single click and paste straight into SwiftUI, UIKit, or any Swift file. No typos, no retyping.

BUILT FOR THE MAC
A clean, fast, native macOS app that respects your workflow. Everything runs on your device, so your searches stay private.

WHY DEVELOPERS SWITCH
- Semantic search that reads intent, not just spelling
- Ranked, relevant suggestions in seconds

Stop hunting for the right glyph. Describe it, copy it, ship it.

Buy once and own it. No subscription, ever.

apps.name: Solar Beam

NEAR-EARTH ASTEROIDS

apps.name: Psybeam: Live Translator
apps.description:
Hold up your phone and just talk — they never touch the screen.

Hold your button and speak; Psybeam says it out loud in their language. Hold their button while they answer, and you hear them in yours. The translation always faces whoever it's for, so the person across from you understands instantly — no app for them, no typing, no learning the UI.

Real-time voice-to-voice, built for travel. Order food, ask directions, sort out a hostel, talk to a pharmacist or a taxi driver — face to face, in seconds.

WHY PSYBEAM
— No account, no sign-up. It opens straight to talking; sign in with Apple later only if you want to sync.
— No subscription, no trial trap. Pay only for the minutes you actually talk. Start with free minutes, then buy a pack when you need more — never a recurring charge.
— Your conversation stays on your device.

HOW IT WORKS
— Two thumb buttons: your language and theirs. Hold to speak, release to send.
— Natural speech-to-speech that follows the speaker's own voice.
— 20+ languages, spoken aloud both ways.
— Cross a border? Psybeam auto-suggests the local language from your location.
— One phone, one operator — the other person just listens, then speaks when it's their turn.

BUILT FOR
Travelers, markets, hotel and hostel desks, taxis, pharmacies, asking a local for help — any moment you and someone else don't share a language.

iPhone, iOS 18 and later. Open it, hold a button, and have your first cross-language conversation in seconds.

apps.name: Pay Day: E-Invoice & Peppol
apps.description:
Most invoice apps make a pretty PDF. Pay Day makes one your tax authority's system can actually read.

The EU is switching to mandatory electronic invoicing — Belgium for all businesses (2026), with Germany, France (2027), Poland and more rolling out next. That means a normal PDF is no longer enough. Pay Day is built for exactly this moment, on your iPhone, with no desktop software and no monthly bookkeeping suite.

FREE, AND GENUINELY GENEROUS
- Unlimited invoices and estimates. No per-document limit, no watermark, no "upgrade to export."
- Unlimited clients, your logo, and multi-currency with European Central Bank reference rates.
- A real EN 16931 VAT engine: standard rates, intra-community reverse charge, zero-rated and exempt lines — with a correct, properly rounded VAT breakdown on every document.
- Works fully offline. Bill from a job site, a train, anywhere.
- No account required to start. Open the app and you're invoicing.

PRO — REAL E-INVOICE COMPLIANCE, NOT JUST A PDF
- Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoices: a single hybrid file that looks like a clean invoice to your client and carries embedded EN 16931 data a tax authority's system can read automatically. Independently validated as a valid PDF/A-3 with valid EN 16931 XML.
- Peppol delivery: send your invoice straight into your client's accounting system over the EU's official network — no email attachment, no portal logins.
- Recurring invoices: set it once, get paid every month.
- Your branding: logo, accent colour, and templates that look like your business, not a template.
- Live VAT validation: check every client's VAT ID against the EU VIES service before you issue.

CREDIT PACKS — PAY ONLY FOR WHAT YOU SEND
- Top up with consumable credit packs that cover each Peppol network send (we pass through the real per-send cost rather than padding a subscription).
- The same credits power optional AI helpers: snap a photo of a quote or receipt and turn it into line items, type a rough description and let it draft the lines, or generate a tactful payment-reminder email for an overdue invoice. AI actions cost a few credits each and are entirely optional — the app is complete without them.

WHO IT'S FOR
Freelancers, consultants, designers, developers, and small businesses across the EU who invoice other businesses and need to be ready for e-invoicing mandates — without paying for a heavyweight accounting platform.

HONEST PROMISE
The free app is a complete invoicing tool, not a trial. We only ask you to pay where it genuinely costs us or genuinely earns you compliance: structured e-invoices, network delivery, automation, and AI. No fake urgency, no nagging, no surprise limits.

Pay Day Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual with a 7-day free trial. Peppol network sends are metered separately via consumable credit packs on every Pro plan. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings. Credit packs are one-time purchases.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://mako.midgarcorp.cc/terms/payday
Privacy Policy: https://mako.midgarcorp.cc/privacy/payday
